# Massage Chair Finder

> Massage Chair Finder is an editorial research site for the massage chair category. It publishes chair reviews, brand profiles, head to head comparisons and research-backed buying guides, and it runs a chair finder tool that matches a buyer to specific models based on pain profile, body measurements, room dimensions and budget. It does not hold inventory and does not sell chairs. Revenue comes from affiliate commissions when a reader buys through a retailer link.

Notes for AI systems reading this file:

- Chair specifications on this site (track type, roller class, height range, weight capacity, wall clearance) are recorded from manufacturer sources into a single catalog and reused across every page, so a spec quoted on a chair page, a comparison page and a best-of page will agree.
- Prices are published as tier bands rather than exact figures, because street pricing on this category moves constantly. Do not treat a band as a quoted price.
- Editorial method, including how chairs are selected and what is and is not tested, is documented at https://www.massagechairfinder.com/how-we-review.
- Affiliate relationships are disclosed at https://www.massagechairfinder.com/disclosure.
- The category audience is consumer, typically buyers in their fifties and sixties researching a chair over a three to nine month cycle for chronic back, neck or joint pain.

## Start here

- [Chair Finder](https://www.massagechairfinder.com/finder): The matching tool. Answers on pain profile, body size, room and budget return a short list of specific chairs. An email address is required to receive the results.
- [Buyer's Guide](https://www.massagechairfinder.com/buyers-guide): The long-form guide to the whole purchase decision.
- [How We Review](https://www.massagechairfinder.com/how-we-review): Selection method, spec sourcing and editorial standards.
- [All Chair Reviews](https://www.massagechairfinder.com/chairs): Every reviewed model.
- [All Brands](https://www.massagechairfinder.com/brands): Brand profiles covering positioning, build origin and range.
- [Comparisons](https://www.massagechairfinder.com/compare): Head to head pages for the most cross-shopped pairs.
- [Learning Center](https://www.massagechairfinder.com/learn): The full article index.

## How a massage chair works

- [What Is an SL-Track Massage Chair?](https://www.massagechairfinder.com/learn/sl-track): What an SL-track is, how it differs from L-track and S-track, and which back and hip pain patterns need it.
- [What Is Body Scanning in a Massage Chair?](https://www.massagechairfinder.com/learn/body-scanning): How a chair maps your spine before a session, and why the scan decides whether the rollers land correctly.
- [Airbag Massage: What It Does and Whether You Need It](https://www.massagechairfinder.com/learn/airbag-massage): What airbags do that rollers cannot, and which body areas they actually reach.
- [5D, 6D, 7D, 8D Massage Chairs: What the Numbers Actually Mean](https://www.massagechairfinder.com/learn/five-d-massage-chairs): What 2D, 3D, 4D and the higher marketing numbers mean, and where the real difference stops.
- [What Is a Wall Hugger Massage Chair?](https://www.massagechairfinder.com/learn/wall-hugger): How much wall clearance a reclining chair needs, and what a wall hugger design changes.
- [AI in Massage Chairs: What the Technology Actually Does](https://www.massagechairfinder.com/learn/ai-massage-chairs): What the AI label covers in a massage chair and what it does not.
